family.description: This family includes homologues of the PIF1 helicase, which inhibits telomerase activity and is cell cycle regulated [[cite:PUB00053693],[cite:PUB00053694],[cite:PUB00151827],[cite:PUB00151828]]. This family includes a large number of largely uncharacterised plant proteins. This entry includes a P-loop motif that is involved in nucleotide binding.
family.name: PIF1-like helicase
